title: 第十一章 突破第十二章 神功出世江湖血祸
slug: 废灵根修炼慢但我长生不死啊
lines: “听说了吗？宋大侠不知怎么的，被挂在京城城门楼上了！”
“死不瞑目，就那么直愣愣看着东宫方向！”
“也没人敢收尸，挂在那儿生了蛆，像是糖粉一样往下掉。”
李水生摇摇头，喝下最后一口果酒。
“小二，结账！”
漫步余唐镇大街上，李水生来到兵器铺子，“铁老大，帮我做个物事。”
铁老大放下锤子，“李大夫要个什么样的。”
“杖刀。”
“就是平常看起来只是根拐杖，关键时刻能抽出来当刀用的那种。”
铁老大笑道：“李大夫这就小看我了不是，小事一桩，保准给您做好。”
“话说李大夫来到镇子上也有二十年了吧，看着真年轻，不愧是杜大夫的弟子，养生有道啊！”
李水生这才想起，自己还是年轻时的模样。
该蓄胡子了。
蓄上淡淡的胡须，手上一卷医书，反而更有医师风范了。
杖刀到手，李水生试了试，铁老大不愧是老行家，轻重适宜，让李水生觉得极为称手。
刀刃细长，是一把细长横刀。
主要是一个大夫出门带一把刀，怎么看都不像是一个正经大夫。
外出做事，突出就是一个隐忍低调，不要引起他人注意。
次年，云州大雨连绵三月，饿殍遍野。
朝臣提出挖开药田，售卖药草给别国，获取粮食。
崇明帝不许。
“朕自继位以来，横扫四方蛮夷，定鼎天下，以不世功勋建太平！”
“朕的子民，需要朕长生久视，给他们更多的恩泽！”
“李大伴，你说他们怎么就不懂呢？”
白眉白发，面白无须的李忠公公，低头顺眉，轻抚皇帝的背。
“陛下息怒，那些愚蠢的贼子，哪里又知道陛下的宏图大愿。”
“都是些只知道惦记碗里那点吃食的贱民罢了。”
崇明帝道：“些许贱民，交给铁甲帝军便可，只是，武林这边.......”
三十年前，有刀魔石傲单刀赴北疆，仗着一把金错刀，万军之中取敌将首级。
宋柏的刀法，便是从石傲处学来。
崇明帝不担心平民，却担心武林宗师。
九千岁李忠笑道：“陛下勿忧，奴婢来给这些武夫找点事儿做。”
李忠来到皇宫藏经阁，吩咐锦衣指挥使蒋献，“去将这八门中品内功，分开散播到江湖中。”
content_en:
"Have you heard? Hero Song is hung up on the gate tower of the capital for some unknown reason!"
"He refused to close his eyes and just stared blankly in the direction of the East Palace!"
"No one dared to collect the body. Maggots had grown on it hanging there, and it fell down like powdered sugar."
Li Shuisheng shook his head and drank the last sip of fruit wine.
"Waiter, check out!"
Walking on the streets of Yutang Town, Li Shuisheng came to the weapons shop and said, "Boss Tie, do me a favor."
Boss Tie put down his hammer and asked, "What kind of thing does Doctor Li want?"
"Staff knife."
"It's the kind that usually looks like a crutch, but can be used as a knife at critical moments."
Tie Lao laughed and said, "Doctor Li, you are looking down on me, right? It's a small matter, I'll make sure it's done well for you."
"By the way, Doctor Li has been in this town for twenty years. He looks so young. He is worthy of being a disciple of Doctor Du. He has a good way of maintaining health!"
Only then did Li Shuisheng remember what he looked like when he was young.
It's time to grow a beard.
With a light beard and a medical book in his hand, he looks more like a doctor.
After getting the staff knife, Li Shuisheng tried it out. Boss Tie was indeed an expert. He had the right weight, which made Li Shuisheng feel very good at it.
The blade is long and slender, and it is a slender horizontal knife.
The main reason is that when a doctor goes out with a knife, he doesn't look like a serious doctor.
When you go out to do things, stand out and keep a low profile, and don't attract other people's attention.
The following year, heavy rains continued for three months in Yunzhou, and people died of hunger all over the country.
The court officials proposed to dig up medicinal fields and sell medicinal herbs to other countries to obtain food.
Emperor Chongming didn't allow it.
"Since I succeeded to the throne, I have swept away the barbarians from all directions, established the world, and established peace with my unparalleled achievements!"
"My people need me to look after them forever and give them more grace!"
"Li Daban, why don't they understand?"
Eunuch Li Zhong, who had white eyebrows and white hair, and a pale face without beard, lowered his head and gently stroked the emperor's back.
"Your Majesty, please calm down. Those stupid thieves have no idea of your Majesty's great ambitions."
"They are all untouchables who only care about the food in the bowl."
Emperor Chongming said: "Some untouchables can be handed over to the Iron Armored Imperial Army, but here in Wulin..."
Thirty years ago, the sword demon Shi Ao went to northern Xinjiang alone. With a golden sword, he killed the enemy general among the thousands of troops.
Song Bai learned his sword skills from Shi Ao.
Emperor Chongming was not worried about the common people, but he was worried about the martial arts masters.
Nine-thousand-year-old Li Zhong smiled and said, "Don't worry, Your Majesty. I'm here to find something to do for these warriors."
Li Zhong came to the Sutra Pavilion of the Imperial Palace and told Jiang Xian, the commander of Jinyi, "Go and spread these eight middle-grade internal skills separately in the Jianghu."
